limitations: Flat square torus and h^{1/2} tube around coordinate geodesic only; no rates for wider O(h) quasimodes, perturbed operators, or non-flat geometries; Diophantine hypothesis not needed for this threshold.

record_title: Shrinking-tube non-scarring for narrow torus quasimodes: o(h^2) tube mass vanishes, hence Diophantine limsup <= 7/8
